name: POV:
summary: POV: - A format in which comedians watch videos from the internet with their own funny description.

previousepisode.name: 5 | РАСУЛ ЧАБДАРОВ, ВАЛЕНТИН СИДОРОВ, НИКИТА АНДРИЕНКО, СЛАВА ГРИДИН

name: Make Me Famous
summary: In Make Me Famous, four already high-profile influencers and reality stars move into a Munich villa with a young creator for seven weeks. They document their everyday life in a shared apartment, but also film themselves at events, parties, and jobs. Will the "high-profile underdog" make the leap into the mainstream with the help of established social media stars?

name: Ex on the Beach
summary: To find new love, a group of hot singles moves into a luxury villa in Mexico. Among the women and men are well-known reality stars who are looking for love in front of the camera again.

name: The Savage
summary: Based on true events, this gritty series follows a notorious Iranian fugitive who outsmarted authorities in a prolonged cat-and-mouse chase through the streets of Tehran.

name: Cankel
summary: Javid Goharian, when he arrives at the factory at the beginning of the week as usual, encounters a different situation. Something has changed...

name: Secrets of the Curry Kitchen
summary: Join Chef Asma Khan in her new show, Secrets of the Curry Kitchen, on a journey through the vibrant world of Indian cuisine.

name: Eye Contact
summary: Nu, a nerdy-looking spectacled boy, was hit by the car driven by Sun, a second-year medical student, resulting in an injury. Before Nu learned that Sun is a famous handsome guy at the university, just making eye contact at that time caused many things to happen.

name: I Promise I Will Come Back
summary: I Promise I Will Comeback tells the touching love story of TK, a young man from northern Thailand, and Victor, a traveler who unexpectedly opens TK's heart. Their bond, born from a fateful meeting and tied by a promise, blossoms into a beautiful journey of love, friendship, and hope.

name: Kun por Agüero
summary: A biographical series that dives into the world of Sergio 'Kun' Agüero - one of Argentina's most iconic and successful football players. As he looks back, he re-examines his life with fresh eyes, gaining a new understanding of his journey and the experiences that have shaped him.

name: Hell Motel
summary: A group of 10 true crime obsessives are invited to the opening weekend of the newly renovated Cold River Motel, the site of a 30-year-old unsolved satanic mass murder. History repeats itself when the guests get stranded and start getting knocked off one by one during a murder spree that grows exponentially more gruesome than the original with each kill.

name: Аллигатор
summary:
The events unfold in August 1943. Work is in full swing in the rear of Alma-Ata: previously evacuated factories are producing weapons: mines, bombs, torpedoes, and flamethrowers. But in the city's dark alleys, gangs, saboteurs, and agents of the Third Reich operate, transforming Alma-Ata into the criminal capital of the USSR.

The series' heroes join the fight against banditry. A counterintelligence officer and a captain are sent from Moscow to assist their Kazakh colleagues. They must spend sleepless nights to prevent a series of sabotage operations and find a German spy.

The series is not only about the fight against banditry, but also about the hospitality of the Kazakh people, who warmly welcomed the evacuees and shared their last bread with them.

name: Love Scam - Die Geschichte eines unglaublichen Betrugs
summary: Singer and actor Matthias Rödder falls in love with a lawyer - but the man of his dreams is leading a double life.

name: Tragédies involontaires
summary: Certain news stories capture our imagination. "Remember the girl who tried to save ducks on the highway?" "What happened to the police officer who accidentally killed a little boy?" Tragédies involontaires revisits 10 shocking cases in which ordinary people unintentionally cause death.

name: Traqueur de chars
summary: With the help of his team, bailiff Michel Gaucher conducts investigations to recover stolen or fraudulently acquired vehicles. No modus operandi escapes him, even the most complex. From a shady garage in the city to the depths of the countryside, he successfully tracks down luxury cars, tractors, and excavators.

name: Vampires, Pirates and Aliens
summary: Vampires, Pirates and Aliens - a madcap animation series featuring blood suckers, swashbucklers, and alien eye-wobblers. Visit nocturnal suburbia and sample Life with the Blods for a taste of everyday life among the undead. Sail the high seas on board The Mad Maggot for rollicking adventures with Captain Blunder and his incompetent crew. Hop from planet to planet with The Extraterrestrials as they search for a way home and a decent square meal, dodging the clutches of the evil Zoomaster as they go!

name: За всех в ответе
summary:
Kira Klinova is an ambulance paramedic, a principled, fair and irrepressible woman. She is one of those people who care about everything. Kira once studied at a medical institute, but got pregnant, married Sergei and left her studies.

Kira always helps people and has already changed the lives of many city residents for the better. The mayor of the city, Pryakhin, noticing her talent, appoints Kira a member of the Public Chamber, and then its chairman. Kira agrees and develops a vigorous activity, torn between a new social burden, work and family. However, in her new position, Kira affects the interests of influential people.

Journalist Alena and the new mayor Ivan Olshansky, with whom Kira was in love many years ago, help her cope with big problems and dangers...

name: ЮФЛ «Лига молодых»
summary: While parents are struggling with loans, disappearing at work, children are looking for fulfillment in soccer clubs. Among the general digital permissiveness, where a kid's word is nothing, there are rules of life in a team, team support, faith and common dreams. The Youth League becomes a guide to the complex world of pro soccer.

name: The Wanted Man
summary: The Wanted Man charts the rise and fall of Felix Carmichael, the elusive and powerful head of notorious British crime syndicate ‘The Capital.' Untouchable for twenty years, Carmichael is finally apprehended, but while he's held in the infamous Staplehurst prison, it becomes clear that he's been betrayed by one of his own. As the traitor moves to dismantle the empire he has built, Carmichael must risk everything in a daring escape. Willing to stop at nothing to take his revenge, if he succeeds, he'll be a wanted man once more.

name: Rabil's Places
summary: Rabil's Places follows Paul Rabil as he explores the rich history and traditions of college and pro lacrosse and pays respects to the game's indigenous origins. From conversations with the biggest names in lacrosse to visiting the cultural hotbeds of the sport, Paul will showcase how lax has continued to grow and evolve into the game we love today.

name: Hakken Over De Sloot
summary: Twelve city influencers trade their luxurious urban lives for the harsh reality of the Dutch countryside. No filters and no oat milk cappuccinos - just early mornings, dirty hands, and fierce competition. They discover that farm life holds more hidden challenges than they ever imagined. Which city dweller will hold their ground? One thing is certain: it won't be a picture-perfect scene...

name: Vanished
summary: When a couple's trip to Paris takes a dark turn with the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend Tom aboard a train to the south of France, Alice is plunged into a web of intrigue and danger, uncovering shocking secrets about the man she thought she knew.

name: Encounter: UFO
summary: Seeing is believing. Encounter: UFO brings to vivid life the most incredible UFO sightings of the modern era. Combining the most compelling visual evidence of UFOs – iPhone footage, video and photographs – with the first-hand accounts of those who were there, Eyewitness UFO takes the biggest mystery of our time and turns it into edge-of-the-seat viewing through riveting, experiential storytelling.

name: Marshals
summary: Marshals stars Luke Grimes reprising his role as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana. Kayce and his teammates - Pete Calvin, Belle Skinner, Andrea Cruz and Miles Kittle - must balance the high psychological cost of serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence with their duty to their families, which for Kayce includes his son Tate and his confidants Thomas Rainwater and Mo from the Broken Rock reservation.

name: R.J. Decker
summary: R.J. Decker centers on the eponymous R.J. Decker, a disgraced newspaper photographer and ex-con who starts over as a private investigator in the colorful-if-crime-filled world of South Florida, tackling cases that range from slightly odd to outright bizarre with the help of his journalist ex, her police detective wife, and a shadowy new benefactor, a woman from his past who could be his greatest ally... or his one-way ticket back to prison.

name: Садовник
summary: One of the main lines of "Gardener" is a homicidal maniac, the prototype of which was the infamous " Bitsevsky maniac. In the Federal Service, the situation is not simple : high management in the Ministry decided to leave only one structure — a specialized division of the Ministry of internal Affairs or an experimental FES. The FES is conducting an operation to catch the killer. And this time, the very existence of the service depends on the results of the team's work.

name: Новости
summary: We see them every day, turning on the TV when we want to know what is happening in the world. Beautiful and impartial news anchors tell about the most important events in the world. But what are they like when the camera turns off? A happy family, a married couple who have succeeded in their careers together? Or hypocrites and liars, whose whole life is built on lies?

name: Los Exitosos Pells
summary: The director of an Argentine news program almost kills the news anchor. When the news anchor is in a coma, the direct finds a replacement physically identical to the original

name: Dig
summary: Dig follows a team of dedicated archaeologists (and less-dedicated college students) who spend their summer working on a dig site in Greece. Their discovery of a rare artifact sends them on the adventure of a lifetime.

name: Endless Night
summary:
It's 1967 and man-of-many-trades Michael Rogers finds himself working as chauffeur for the enigmatic designer du jour Rudolf Santonix, snatching a glimpse into a glamorous world of outrageous wealth that's far from his own upbringing. Transfixed by Santonix's latest project, a beautiful house in the English countryside, Mike dreams of meeting the love of his life and taking up residence. But unbeknownst to Mike, the house that he has set his heart on has a dark past that goes back for centuries. Local legend says that it is haunted by a curse that no one escapes.

When Mike meets the sweet-natured Ellie and, by a curious set of circumstances, finds himself moving into the house, the young couple start to realise they should have listened to the warnings. As increasingly strange and chilling events occur, they start to wonder if the curse is real and means to destroy them. Or, that someone is intent on terrifying them to death.

A ghost story and a love story, Endless Night is about obsession and the darkness that lurks in us all when we want too much.

name: Drag In The Dark
summary: The UK's fiercest drag queens join the South East Paranormal Team to slay the supernatural, serving ghost hunts with glamour, screams with sass, and terror with a touch of makeup

name: Dutton Ranch
summary:
The Dutton Ranch, home to Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler, is a testament to the peace they sought, fought for, and nearly died for, as they've come to cherish their 7,000-acre land. With tough times and stiff competition, Beth and Rip do what they must to survive, all while ensuring Carter becomes the man he's supposed to be.

As Beth and Rip fight to build a future together - far from the ghosts of Yellowstone - they collide with brutal new realities and a ruthless rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire. In South Texas, blood runs deeper, forgiveness is fleeting, and the cost of survival might just be your soul.

name: El nuevo mundo de los gnomos
Divorce Day my three brothers took me home
Super Mega Cakes
summary: Super Mega Cakes pushes his skill and talent to the next level. In the six-episode series, Team Duff goes up against six teams of the country's best cake artists over the course of four days - all at once. With themes from Superman and Architectural Wonders to Classic Cartoons, the results are mind-blowingly realistic pieces of edible art with intricate details and interactive elements. In the end, the finalist cakes are presented and tasted by a 50-person audience who will name the grand champion.

name: 1000-lb Roomies
summary: 1000-lb Roomies a bold, unfiltered and heart-filled new series that proves friendship really is the best medicine. Join Jasmine aka "Jaz" and Nesha, two vibrant personalities who went from online strangers to inseparable friends and roommates, as they embark on a mission to reclaim their health.

name: Drunter und Drüber – Chaos auf dem Friedhof
summary: The cemetery director is crushed by a rotten gravestone. Heli Wondratschek then sees his goal as having finally taken over and restored order at Donnersbach Cemetery. However, the pedantic deputy director hasn't reckoned with the city administration. The top job doesn't go to him, but rather to a superior who knows absolutely nothing about cemeteries: Ursula Fink.

name: Gen Well
summary: Explores some of the nation's key health and wellness concerns such as pain management, women's health, sleep and stress.

name: High School Heiress
summary: When her bad behavior makes headlines, the royal palace decides Princess Adeline needs a reality check and thrusts her out of the palace and into the hallways of Attaway High, where she must learn to connect with her peers, embrace life as a normal kid, and discover that being a true princess means understanding and serving others.

previousepisode.name: Teen Movie Star Forced To Join Public School!

name: Secrets of the Bunny Ranch
summary: Secrets of the Bunny Ranch pulls back the curtain on the inner workings of the Moonlite Bunny Ranch, exploring the impact the infamous brothel had on the women who worked there. At the center of the Bunny Ranch was owner Dennis Hof, viewed by his supporters as a prostitution liberator who worked to destigmatize the profession.  Featuring interviews with former Bunny Ranch workers—many speaking for the first time—the documentary reveals how women drawn in by the promise of a better life through the glamourous world portrayed on Cathouse instead allege they faced a hidden reality marked by bullying, humiliation, manipulation, sexual assault and even murder. Other episodes explore topics including a detailed account of former professional basketball player Lamar Odom's near-death experience from those who were there and Dennis Hof's political ambitions vying for a seat in the state assembly. With never-before-seen footage, personal photos, and unprecedented access to ex-employees and Cathouse crew members, the series exposes a far more complicated legacy of Dennis Hof and the Bunny Ranch than the carefree image portrayed on television.

name: 5 Arany Gyűrű
summary: RTL's brand new game show hosted by Gábor Gundel-Takács.

name: Duna - Árral szemben
summary: The Danube River passes ten countries on its nearly 1900-mile journey from the German Black Forest to the Black Sea. British correspondent Nick Thorpe has lived by the river for more than half his life. Now he travels against the current and hopes to find "Europe's lost heart" in the meeting with the people, the cities and nature.

name: Through the Drama
summary: In each episode, Harrison and Zima, married October 2023, take viewers through the drama of the day's most captivating stories, offering unfiltered takes on trending entertainment and lifestyle topics — from the celebrity chaos on the coasts to the issues that matter most in middle America. With their signature blend of humor and heart, they deliver a fresh, positive spin on the day's headlines, bringing audiences the drama, minus the stress.

name: Duel
summary: In the Slovak Television's knowledge competition, hosted by Gregor Mareš, two opponents will compete, as is customary in duels. In three competition rounds, they have the opportunity to compare and turn their knowledge from various areas of life into money. An attractive novelty is undoubtedly the immediate handover of the entire financial prize to the winner at the end of the show. Of course, if he does not decide to continue playing and winning.

name: Le Grand Chantier Rona
summary: As home ownership becomes increasingly difficult, 12 couples compete in a renovation competition to realize their biggest dream: become owners! They will have 10 weeks to surpass themselves at GRAND CHANTIER RONA in order to win a new fully furnished house worth $700,000.

name: Best Medicine
summary: In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

previousepisode.name: Breakin' in Is Hard to Do

name: Virgin Island
summary: More people are remaining virgins for longer, but now 12 courageous adult virgins embark on a unique intimacy course, at a luxury Mediterranean retreat, to overcome their intimacy anxiety

name: Sloinne
summary: A new series of Sloinne in which a person goes in search of the history of their surname in each episode begins on TG4. We travel all over the country learning about famous and historical figures as well as the clans which shaped the history of Ireland.

name: The Troops
summary: Set against the backdrop of ongoing geopolitical uncertainty, The Troops, will take viewers to the front line of modern soldiering and paint an illuminating, multifaceted picture of what it means to serve in the British Army in 2025.

name: Drift
summary: Drift is about a 20-something group of friends in BXL, each of whom gets lost in their urges for love, sex and adventure. The story begins when Luna and Lode decide to open their relationship. Luna hopes for more tension and passion into their drowsy sex life. But soon Luna's drive and urge spreads through the group of friends.

name: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
summary: A shady, self-proclaimed hermit named Momoyuki Mogura is banned from the afterlife. Now, he collects spirit-possessed will-o'-the-wisps in his lantern, hoping to make a comeback. Oddly enough, it seems that all those who encounter Mogura begin to see peculiar things. A mysterious and comedic story begins where the lives of the living and ghosts interact in the here and now!

name: NBC Experiment in Television
summary: An attempt by NBC to emulate the success of the CBS hit The Twilight Zone, this hour-long anthology series showcased different actors, stories and creative talent each week.

name: The Faithful: Women of the Bible
summary: The Faithful: Women of the Bible is inspired by the best-selling book of all time, the Bible, and showcases a faithful dramatization of the Book of Genesis as told through the eyes of the courageous and passionate, yet flawed women whose descendants would shape the future of faith as we know it today. Dimensional, dramatic, intimate, even surprising, The Faithful: Women of the Bible is about discovering and losing love, the challenges of marriage, the joys and heartbreak of children, confronting temptation, and finding faith. Episodes of The Faithful will be told through the lens of five of The Old Testament's most legendary women: Sarah and her maidservant Hagar, Sarah's great-niece Rebekah, and Rebekah's nieces, sisters Leah and Rachel.

previousepisode.name: The Woman Who Loved, Part Two

name: Costanza
summary: A young Sicilian pathologist wins a one-year research grant in Verona and leaves her homeland to pursue new professional opportunities

name: Infieles
summary: Erotic comedy about infidelity and the different situations that lead human beings to commit it.

name: I Love Tokyo Legend - Kawaii Detective
summary: Detective Tsukiko Otonashi, who is obsessed with the "Toshi Densetsu" manga, believes all kinds of crimes are somehow linked to urban legends.

previousepisode.name: Legend of the beautiful vampire acrtess who die twice

name: Never Fair
summary: To get a job in Seoul, Jin Woo-hyuk ended up living at the house of his mom's friend's son, On Yu, a successful writer. And that's how it all began...

name: Langer
summary:
Piotr Langer, a young and dashing businessman who inherited a financial holding company from his tragically deceased father. In his spare time, Piotr indulges in his longtime passion - he is an elusive serial killer who has been pursued unsuccessfully by prosecutors for years.

One day a stunning woman, Nina, appears in his life, and in order to attract Langer's attention and get closer to him, she shows up at his charity gala. Soon after, she becomes involved in a dangerous game and a relationship with Langer, which doesn't make it any easier for her to uncover evidence that he is a serial killer. Will justice prevail this time...?

name: TV 2 avslører
summary: TV 2 avslører brings you exclusive stories from TV 2's investigative journalists.

name: Ted: The Animated Series
summary: Ted: The Animated Series is a sequel to the Ted and Ted 2 films. Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. The series follows these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

name: Talkback
summary: Malcolm White is the hard-talking, right-leaning king of talkback radio. But when a younger, left-leaning personality takes the number one spot, how far will Malcolm go to rule the airwaves again?

name: Game Bros.
summary: Two brothers buy a video game store to try and turn it into a successful business. With the worst employees and time running out, what could go wrong?

name: Ensaios: O Corpo Feminino
summary: This Documentary Series will present the best fashion photographers in Brazil. Those artists will expose their hobbies and styles while photographing beautiful women in the most unexpected and creative situations.

name: The Adventures of Danny & The Dingo
summary: The Adventures of Danny & The Dingo follows two-time Olympic snowboarding medalist Danny Kass and Australia's number-one export and snow personality, The Dingo, on their adventures around the world. On this new season catch more action with cultural exchanges, Indian Names assignment, World Beard and Moustache Championships and many more.

name: Amsterdam Centraal 24/7
summary: There is a unique station in the heart of the bustling metropolis of Amsterdam: Amsterdam Central Station. Behind the historic facade of this iconic monument, 900 dedicated men and women do their utmost every day to keep everything running smoothly. During the largest renovation in its history, they are constantly challenged to be prepared for the unexpected.

name: Change Your Mind, Change Your Life
summary: Can therapy change your life? Matt and Emma Willis join people's transformational journeys as they are paired with leading therapists and talk through the things that many of us face.

name: Murderer Behind the Mask
summary:
When a vulnerable woman goes missing in the Dublin Mountains police assume she has committed suicide. But a chance discovery by a group of fishermen, kick starts an incredible murder investigation that leads to the door of a very surprising suspect. 

Graham Dwyer is a successful architect and a happily married father of two. But he is leading a double life of twisted kinks and violent fetishes and now the police suspect, even murder. Dwyer has covered his tracks well and thinks he's got away with his crime but painstaking detective work finally unmasks the killer and puts him
behind bars.

With testimony from eye witnesses and exclusive access to the Irish police force (The Garda) we hear first hand from the detectives about the incredible investigation and how they out smarted Dwyer and brought him to justice.

name: A.MAR, donde el amor teje sus redes
summary: Estrella Contreras, a single mother struggling to raise her daughter Azul, finds herself having to return to her hometown after the fateful death of her father Ulises, where she meets Fabián Bravo, a widowed father and fisherman by profession who is fighting to regain custody of his teenage daughter Yazmin. Love blossoms between them, but it will be complicated by the intrigues of Érika Méndez, Fabián's ex-partner, and the ambition of Sergio Falcón, a powerful businessman and Azul's father, who will relentlessly seek to prevent this relationship, even if it means ending the customs and traditions of an entire fishing village, which will lead Fabián and Estrella to face a hurricane of calamities, always putting the well-being of their families first.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Acepto casarme con Fabián

name: The Bakersfield 3: A Tale of Murder and Motherhood
summary: When two friends go missing back-to-back, and in between their disappearances, a third friend is murdered, their mothers begin their own investigation.

name: Mini Reni
summary: Known for her large-scale renovations, Joanna Gaines takes on the challenge to renovate three rooms in one week. In each episode, she makes a few budget-friendly changes to completely transform outdated spaces in need of a refresh.

previousepisode.name: Hoda Gets an Inspiring New Office

name: Nowe Rozdanie: Rhythm + Flow Polska
summary: Aspiring Polish rappers drop bars, battle, and craft tracks to impress judges Bedoes 2115, DZIARMA, and Sokół — vying for fame and a 500,000 złoty prize.

name: Single Voices
summary: A series of dramatic monologues.

name: Downtown Lagos
summary: Solicitor Mungo Dawson finds his orderly world collapsing when he is assigned to a Nigerian fraud case, and defendants start to disappear.

name: Meal Deals: Behind the Bargain
summary: In this brand-new programme, Joe Swash investigates the meal deal phenomenon to find the most surprising revelations about this uniquely British consumer obsession.

name: Black Hearts in Battersea
summary: Children's period drama serial. In early nineteenth century London the rightful Duke finds himself cheated out of his inheritance.

name: Baddies Africa
summary: The ladies travel to the Motherland for their next Baddies tour.

name: Baddies Gone Wild
summary: A group of young Baddie hopefuls run wild in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

name: The Survivors
summary: Fifteen years ago, the loss of three young people tore this sleepy seaside town apart. Now, the mysterious death of a young woman dredges up the past.

name: The Real Housewives van het Zuiden
Memory of a Killer
summary: Memory of a Killer is a dramatic thriller about a hitman who develops early onset Alzheimer's. Angelo lives a double life as an assassin and a family man - which all worked out well until he was hit with early onset Alzheimer's. Now his worlds are colliding, putting his family in danger.

name: 99 to Beat
summary: In 99 to Beat, 100 contestants go head-to-head in a range of visually distinctive and hilarious games in an arced competition game show like we've never seen before. 99 to Beat is the game show that anyone can win, and there's only one thing players must do for a chance of walking away with the cash prize – Don't. Come. In. Last. As contestants battle it out against each other, each round will see the number of players whittled down until one person is left standing and they take home the top prize of $100,000.

name: Celebrity Weakest Link
summary: A rapid-fire quiz show in which eight celebrities compete to win up to one million dollars for the charity of their choosing, these celebs will answer general knowledge questions and bank money as a group across multiple rounds. At the end of each round, the contestants vote out who they perceive to be the weakest link, and the host sends them off with the phrase, "You are the Weakest Link. Goodbye." The two who make it to the final round will battle it out to determine who wins the banked money for their charity.

name: A Voyage of Discovery: The Ocean Race
summary: This exclusive three-part documentary follows The Ocean Race and its five teams in 2023. Behind-the-scenes footage from each vessel shows crew members enduring the unique challenges and drama of sailing's toughest round-the-world race.

name: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
summary: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins focuses on a disgraced former football player, who is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

name: Head Over Heels
summary: Park Seong A is a high school student, but, at night, she is a shaman named Fairy Cheon Ji. When she works as a shaman, she covers her face partially to hide her identity. She is famous as Fairy Cheon Ji and she is busy working with her clients who come to ask about their future, fortune, illnesses, and other things. One night, Bae Gyeon U and his mother come to visit Fairy Cheon Ji. Park Seong A has a crush on him at first sight, but she sees that he is destined to die soon. The next day, Bae Gyeon U appears in front of her as a new transfer student in her class. She decides to save him from his destiny.

name: Our Movie
summary: The story of a film director suffering from a Sophomore jinx and a time-limited actor who wants to live as the main character of his life only at the end of his life.

name: Homo universalis
summary:
Can you boil an egg? Do you know the difference between left and right? If yes, you can win!

Homo universalis is a game show format which is simple and universal in appeal. 100 contestants go head-to-head in a series of challenges with only one rule: DON'T COME LAST.

After every challenge, the person who loses must leave the competition, counting down from 100 to just 1. The multi-talented last man standing will take the grand prize home. And have beaten the 99!

name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
summary: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

name: The Paper
summary: The Paper finds the same documentary crew that immortalized Dunder Mifflin Scranton searching for a new subject. They ultimately find it in an historic Toledo newspaper, The Truth Teller, and the eager publisher that's trying to revive it.

name: Kimora: Back in the Fab Lane
summary: This fierce fashionista – now a single mom of five – commands an empire while running her iconic Baby Phat brand and juggling a billion-dollar business portfolio. Between dealing with the whims of her top-model daughters, cheering at her sons' championship games and celebrating her own major milestones, Kimora's world is even more fabulous and outrageous than ever before. Buckle up.

name: Everything on the Menu with Braun Strowman
summary: Everything on the Menu with Braun Strowman follows WWE Legend Braun Strowman as he eats his way across America, while on the road for WWE, ordering everything on every menu and trying to down every last bite.

name: Russell Harty at the Seaside
summary: Each week Russell Harty visits a seaside location in the United Kingdom.

name: Nelly & Ashanti: We Belong Together
summary: Nelly & Ashanti: We Belong Together follows the electrifying journey of this beloved couple as they reignite their love, navigate the ups and downs of newlywed life and the challenges of parenthood while juggling their thriving careers. Can this unstoppable duo prove that their love truly can conquer all? A fun-filled exploration of love's second chances.

previousepisode.name: The Way That I Love You

name: Tiffany Haddish Goes Off
summary: Tiffany Haddish Goes Off follows superstar Tiffany Haddish and her three closest childhood girlfriends as they travel together on a 4-week-long girls' trip of a lifetime, exploring Africa and their connection to the continent. We'll see them bonding, confiding, confessing, growing and looking for love on this journey. This raw, vulnerable and unpredictable version of Tiffany Haddish leaves the viewer crying with laughter and sobbing from heartfelt, relatable, real-time self-healing.

name: Epic Ride: The Story of Universal Theme Parks
summary: Epic Ride: The Story of Universal Theme Parks celebrates the history and legacy of Universal Destinations & Experiences. Through unprecedented access, rare archival and intimate interviews with directors, producers, executives, and A-list celebrities, the series will explore Universal's iconic film and theme park history as well as provide an exclusive behind-the-scenes countdown to the opening of its groundbreaking new theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

name: Gilgo Beach Killer: The House of Secrets
summary: After the arrest of the alleged Gilgo Beach killer, this 3-part series goes inside the suspect's home for the first time, where never-before-heard testimony from his own family unravels a chilling portrait of a man accused of living a double life and hiding dark secrets under their own roof.

name: Breaking the Deadlock
summary:
Breaking the Deadlock brings together people from across the political spectrum in a way that requires them to go beyond the usual talking points and speak to our core values as Americans," said moderator Aaron Tang. "By using hypothetical scenarios that rhyme with reality, we create space for honest introspection and conversation—and even some surprising breakthroughs."

Each episode of Breaking the Deadlock dives into essential questions of community, accountability and personal responsibility, sparking legal, moral and ethical reflections. As each hypothetical scenario unfolds with unexpected twists, both panelists and viewers are challenged to confront the thought-provoking question: "What would I do?"

name: E! Dirty Rotten Scandals
summary: E! Dirty Rotten Scandals explores the scandalous, behind-the-scenes stories of television shows, focusing on the drama, controversy, and unexpected events that unfold both on and off-screen.

name: Anna Pigeon
summary: Anna Pigeon is a former city slicker who became a park ranger after a devastating loss changed the trajectory of her life forever. While Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds, no matter who or what gets in her way.

name: The Death Investigator with Barbara Butcher
summary: The first true-crime series told through the eyes of Barbara Butcher, one of the most seasoned and respected Death Investigators to work in New York. After more than 20 years in the field, Butcher will unpack the stories behind some of the most compelling murders of our times  — revealing that the keys to solving the case are often contained in the wealth of information held by the crime scene and the body that lies within it.

name: The Killer Among Us
summary: Hosted by Alan Cumming, a shocking murder rocks a tight-knit community to its core. But what if the crime wasn't committed by a stranger or outsider? What if this killer is part of the community itself? Cumming brings us straight into the heart of communities where the unthinkable has happened and no one knows why — or who is responsible. If everyone is a suspect… who can you trust? With multiple suspects, layers of lies, deceit and deception, The Killer Among Us is a murder mystery where someone is playing… but it's not a game.

name: The Death Row Informant
summary: Over a decade ago, a gruesome killer was convicted of murdering four women. Though police could never prove it, investigators always suspected there were many more victims. But the killer took his secrets with him to San Quentin. When he arrived on death row, a fellow inmate offered him protection on the yard. Over the course of a decade, the killer confided in this inmate, revealing details about 20+ unsolved murders for the first time. This inmate-turned-informant has now handed over 300 pages of detailed notes about the killer's unsolved murders to Ken Mains, an ex-FBI investigator and cold case detective. Mains will work together with the informant to uncover new victims, bring closure to families, and expose one of America's most prolific serial killers in real-time.

name: The Silent Serial Killer: Gretzler
summary: He is the serial killer you've never heard of … until now. In 1973, 22-year-old Doug Gretzler embarked on a cross-country road trip that spiraled into a brutal killing spree. In just three weeks, he and his accomplice, 28-year-old Willie Steelman, murdered 17 people. Their motive? A mystery that has left family members, law enforcement and experts baffled for decades. Drawing from first person interviews and over 500 hours of recorded conversations with Gretzler himself, hear his darkest confessions and the chilling psychology behind his crimes for the very first time.

name: Killer Grannies
summary: A true-crime series that chronicles the most shocking and unpredictable cases involving a killer no one would suspect: Grandma. In every self-contained episode, a rollercoaster ride of a case unfolds as investigators dig deep and chase every lead until they finally catch their unexpected killer. Through gripping archival footage, selective recreations and cinematic imagery, and in-depth interviews with investigators, prosecutors, friends and family, every episode will peel back the plastic cover on the couch to uncover a world of sinister plots and evil deeds unpacking why and how these maternal matriarchs of the family can turn deadly.

name: Chespirito: Sin Querer Queriendo
summary: A heartfelt biographical series following the rise to fame of beloved Mexican comic and cultural icon Roberto Gómez Bolaños – AKA Chespirito.

name: Terror på ambassaden
summary: In April 1975, six young German terrorists stormed the West German embassy in Stockholm. A dramatic hostage crisis unfolded, with deadly consequences. For twelve tense hours, the world watched as Stockholm police and Olof Palme's government tried to resolve the situation — a life-and-death negotiation ending in catastrophe. The documentary offers unique insights through unheard testimonies from hostages, police, and relatives.

name: Fear Factor: House of Fear
summary: Fear Factor: House of Fear is coming back bigger, bolder and more daring. Dropped into an unforgiving, remote location, a group of strangers will live together under one roof, and face mind-blowing stunts, harrowing challenges and a twisted game of social strategy where trust is fleeting - and fear is a weapon.

previousepisode.name: Fear Factor: 48 Hours of Fear - Part 2

name: Gerri
summary: Thirty-five years old, with deep eyes and a shifty demeanour, Gregorio Esposito, known as Gerri, is an inspector of Roma origin who solves cases under the Puglia sun. Charming, restless, and with a mysterious past, he throws himself headlong into investigations, incurring the ire of the chief of the squad and the affection of his colleagues.

name: 0.5 no Otoko
summary:
The story revolves around the Tachibana family, who live in a 2.5-generation household. In this type of household, the parents and their children live together in a two-generation home, with the addition of a single sibling from the younger generation. The Tachibana family decides to rebuild their old home into a 2.5-generation household, and the 40-year-old unemployed and reclusive protagonist, Masaharu Tachibana, ends up living with his sister and her family.

Although Masaharu is revered as a gaming expert in the virtual world, he faces challenges in his new living situation as his sister asks him to help with household chores, and his teenage niece rejects him as "weird." Having lived life at his own pace until now, Masaharu gradually learned to interact with people and regain a more social lifestyle amidst the changing environment.

name: The Lowdown
summary: The Lowdown follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

name: Сетка
summary: When the studio turns into a TNT backstage, and the guests turn into a source of truth, jokes, and a bit of drama. "Grid" is a podcast where the channel's stars talk about filming, premieres and everything that remains behind the scenes. Artificial intelligence is not just a background here — it provokes, analyzes, and sometimes confuses guests. In the studio — the top of the air: psychics, actors, fighters, presenters. Real conversations about television with those who make it.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 14 - Юля Коваль, Иван Пышненко, Мария Погребняк, Алана Мамаева

name: Линия судьбы
summary: On the eve of the wedding, Vera jokingly comes to a fortune teller, but the prediction she receives turns the girl's life upside down. The wedding is cancelled, and Vera herself begins searching for a mysterious stranger whose fate is inextricably linked with her own. Mysterious coincidences, curses and karma... In the end, everything will find a rational explanation. Everything except love. After all, in the history of a real great feeling there is always a place for magic.

name: Designing Paradise with Bill Bensley
summary: Designing Paradise takes viewers into the extraordinary world of Bill Bensley, one of hospitality design's most visionary minds.

name: Not a Box
summary:
The series is inspired by the beloved, award-winning children's picture book of the same name by the New York Times bestselling author and illustrator Antoinette Portis. Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds — full of new friends and fantastic adventures.

Series invites young viewers and their families to create, explore and celebrate as they step into a rich world of environments, characters and encounters that is as limitless as their imaginations.

name: Os Donos do Jogo
summary: The Rio de Janeiro crime mafia is in turmoil with the imminent legalization of gambling, the interest of a foreign criminal group in the local market and the rapid rise of Profeta, a new aspirant to the city's throne.

name: Wild Things
summary: Wild Things tells the wild ride relationship tale of two of the greatest showmen-magicians in history who, along with their white tigers, are tasked with turning Sin City into a family-friendly destination. The duo push the concept of illusion versus reality to the extreme, personally and professionally, until tragedy reframes and opens a mystery surrounding their last fateful Las Vegas show.

name: Opérations Spéciales
summary: Thanks to previously unseen accounts and high-quality reconstructions, this series chronicles for the first time the most daring and delicate covert operations conducted by special forces in recent years. From their preparation at the operations center to their execution in the field, three missions are detailed here step by step.

name: ДЖИГАНИНА
summary: If you haven't shuddered yet, now is the time! In our intellectual quiz, participants will battle it out with Master Dzhigan in a fight for the main prize - a crystal goat

previousepisode.name: #18 - Артур Бабич, Konfuz, Амиран Сардаров, Джиган, Валерий Равдин

name: Split Ends
summary: Cath is a beautiful woman in her thirties, who runs a hairdresser's shop. Each episode sees Cath trying to decide if she wants to be with Clint or David.

name: Maharal
summary: The adventurous journey to the fabled treasure and deciphering the secrets of ancient talisman.

name: Létajíci Cestmír
summary: Young boy Cestmir finds a magic rock which allows him to bring the seeds of the flowers which allow flying from Blue Planet...

name: Miss Sophie - Same Procedure as Every Year
summary: Same procedure as every year? Not this year! Young Miss Sophie, short on money, invites eligible bachelors to her country estate. But before she can make her choice, one of the suitors is murdered. As the remaining candidates compete for her heart, she secretly tries to uncover the killer. Always by her side is Butler James - and a tender yet seemingly impossible romance begins to unfold.

name: Meihao Shenghuo
summary: On the brink of divorce, a Chinese man returns home after 10 years in America. At the airport, he suffers a heart attack but survives thanks to a transplant that gives him another chance in life.

name: What We Know with Max Foster
summary: Drawing on Foster's decades of experience covering major world events both on scene and in the studio, What We Know will provide a definitive roundup of the day's top stories, and a deeper dive into the questions sparking debate around the world.

name: The Kingdom
summary:
The Kingdom was filmed over the course of the 2024 season and includes unprecedented access into the players' lives on and off the field – details the Chiefs' journey as the club completed a franchise-record 15-win regular season, captured a third-consecutive Lamar Hunt Trophy as AFC champions, and made a third-straight Super Bowl appearance in New Orleans. The remarkable run builds upon nearly a decade of tremendous success, during which the team made the playoffs every year (2015-24), won the AFC West Division title nine years running (2016-24), appeared in the AFC Championship Game seven years in a row (2018-24), and ultimately made five Super Bowl appearances over the past six years, raising the hallowed Vince Lombardi Trophy three times.  

Told through the lens of current-day players, coaches, and executive leaders, following them both on and off the field all season long, the series will also weave together tales of the team's long and celebrated history, its proud culture, as well as the Chiefs' deeply ingrained place in the Kansas City community and the wider sports landscape.

Along the way, the series will spotlight the 65-year history of the Chiefs franchise dating back to its earliest days in Dallas, Texas, when the team was founded by the legendary sports innovator Lamar Hunt. It will explore the many highs and lows of the club's iconic path to modern-day dynasty, detailed by countless untold stories and behind-the-scenes moments that have shaped its legacy. With exclusive access to the organization's extensive and rarely seen photo and video archives, coupled with intimate interviews with players, coaches, and other key figures, the series will offer a fascinating look at the team's long path to the pinnacle of the sports world.

name: Vibe Check
summary: Vibe Check will deliver fast-paced coverage of every sport with expert analysis, all-access moments, unapologetic opinions and a healthy dose of laughter – all while bringing audiences bold perspectives and unbeatable vibes. Featuring a powerhouse panel of female talent, the program will spotlight ESPN's most prominent voices, leveraging their expertise, insight, and storytelling to provide a fresh, perspective-driven approach to sports coverage. With a focus on delivering a modern, cross-platform experience, the show will offer dynamic content tailored for digital and social platforms in addition to Disney+.

name: Amore unter Palmen - Fremdenverkehr und mehr
summary: The Austrian docu-soap looks for people who met their partners via social networks or on vacation and are now forced to have a long-distance relationship. Under the eyes of the cameras, couples who are otherwise separated by thousands of kilometers are reunited.

name: Shuangsheng Wu Hun
summary: Lin Fan, who was born in a noble family in Dalin County, was originally a peerless genius who was awarded the Tianjiao Order, but his martial soul was taken away by his fiancée, and he became a waste. When a mysterious demon parasitized Lin Fan and reactivated his abandoned martial soul, making him a rare dual martial soul physique, Lin Fan officially embarked on the road to rise, from a small county town to the heavens and the worlds.

name: Death Valley
summary: Curmudgeonly retired actor meets eager young detective - they're the perfect crime-fighting duo, if they can only get along.

name: War Machine: World War II
summary: A four-part documentary focusing on technological progress during the Second World War, which understandably benefited warfare in particular during this period.

name: Department of Offense
summary: A collection of skits and ads that make light heart of military and Veteran life.

name: Aussie Road Train Truckers
summary: Aussie Road Train Truckers follows a cast of charismatic road train drivers as they haul monster pay loads across the Outback in some of the biggest trucks on the planet.

name: Chinese Puzzle
summary: Martin Frazer and daughter Alison find themselves targeted by two sinister characters, China Smith and Larry Johnson. Watched by curious 10-year-old son of the licensee, Paul Jameson who becomes involved in an unforgettable adventure.

name: Кулинарный техникум
summary: In his native Staroozersk, the capital's chef, Slava Vinogradov, is waiting not only for his father, the head teacher of the local culinary college, but also for a real surprise - a son, whose existence Slava had not known for seventeen years. In order to get to know the teenager better, one of the college students, and establish a relationship with Vinogradov Sr., the fashionable chef becomes a teacher at the educational institution.

name: Y a-t-il un dealer dans l'avion ?
summary: On March 20, 2013, four French nationals are arrested on board a private jet in the Punta Cana airport, Dominican Republic: two ex-air force pilots and two passengers about to take off for Saint-Tropez. On board: 700 kg of cocaine stored in 26 suitcases. None of them has the profile of an international drug smuggler and no one knows who the luggage belongs to. Who isn't telling the whole truth? Who's involved in the case? And what is hiding behind the mountain of drugs?

name: Loy Kaew First Love
summary: Loy, a kind-hearted farmer's son, falls for Kaew, the village headman's son and his close friend. Their romance faces challenges from Kaew's sister and Phat, who both love Loy. As Phat vows to destroy him, Kaew must choose whether to protect Loy.

name: След. Новые легавые
summary:
The legendary investigator of the FES, Major Nikolai Kruglov, leaves the service and returns to his hometown, where he is going to quietly meet old age. Kruglov hides from his friends that his resignation was a forced measure: as a result of his mistake, an inexperienced operative ended up in a coma. 

The idyll prevailing in his small homeland turns out to be deceptive, and Kruglov himself quickly turns from a well-deserved pensioner into a dangerous fugitive and hostage-taker. 

The investigation begins with local young police officers: two twin brothers — operative Stas and investigator Andrei, as well as criminologist Aglaya. With the help of Maisky and Rogozina, Kruglov uncovers the gang and frees the hostages. 

Kruglov is invited to give a course of lectures at the University of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, where his students are "new cops" — Stas Shcherbakov, Danila Bestuzhev and Aglaya Titova. They have not only theory ahead of them, but also practice in solving crimes, in which they cannot do without Kruglov's wise advice.

name: Караоке клаб
summary: KARAOKE CLUB is a friendly vocal and entertainment competition in the relaxed atmosphere of Garik Kharlamov's Karaoke Club, in which star teams participate in non-banal karaoke music contests

name: The Day of the Triffids
summary: Triffids are towering, poisonous, predatory plants that begin eradicating the remaining population after a meteor shower blinds the majority of people on Earth. Bill Masen guides the survivors in their battle with the deadly plants.

name: Iolo: Natur Bregus Cymru
summary: During an age in which wildlife is under threat, Iolo looks at the state of Wales' nature.

name: The Kimberley
summary: Embark on an incredible journey with award-winning actor Mark Coles Smith as he explores one of Australia's most remote and majestic landscapes.

name: The Secret DNA of Us
summary: Discover Australia's hidden history with Marc Fennell and his team through groundbreaking mass DNA testing across four Australian towns.

name: Maschi veri
summary: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.

name: Favàritx
summary: Inspector Marta Serra, exiled in Menorca, investigates a serial killer who stages suicides. Alongside her partner Alex Crespo, she uncovers a real estate corruption scheme run by the Portuguese mafia.

name: Salon de Holmes
summary: There is never a quiet day at Gwangseon Jugong Apartments! From noise complaints and suspicious neighbors to the petty villains who drive everyone mad, the incidents are non-stop. Fed up, four women join forces: Gong Miri, a sharp-eyed deduction specialist; Choo Kyungja, a former detective whose fists move faster than the law; Park Sohee, the ultimate neighborhood informant; and Jeon Jihyun, a former insurance sales star who knows everyone's business. As a single unit, they tackle the complex's chaos with a flawless division of labor. What begins as investigations into mundane apartment life soon spirals out of control, revealing shocking missing links. Joined by laughter and fierce loyalty, this unstoppable "womance" team is ready for action!

name: A.J. Wentworth, B.A.
summary: Set in a 1940s English school, Lowe stars in the title role as a maths teacher obsessed with the honour of his school, the high cost of pen nibs and the sneaky tactics of his arch-enemy, the school Matron.

name: Nature's Mass Attacks
summary: Nature's Mass Attacks follows the world's best pack hunters as they cooperate to take down prey – from the iconic grey wolf to the surprising collaboration between humans and dolphins, these are predators at their most inventive and cunning.

name: Dead or Love
summary: A devoted husband with a murderous secret and his loving wife face turmoil in their marriage when a female journalist's death disrupts their seemingly perfect life.

name: Hey Beautiful: Anatomy of a Romance Scam
summary: Hey Beautiful: Anatomy of a Romance Scam follows the story of three women - Annette, Roxy and Gaby - who fall head-over-heels in love with the same handsome man, only to discover they have been swindled out of their money in an elaborate romance scam. Heartbroken and furious, they fight back to uncover the scammer's true identity. Their shocking search leads them to a man with more secrets than they could have imagined. As they begin to seek justice, they learn that escaping the scam may become a matter of life and death.

name: Doménica Montero
summary: Betrayed, humiliated, and left with nothing, a powerful woman rebuilds her life on her family's forgotten land—only to face new enemies, forbidden love, and a past that won't let her go.

name: El Conquistador
summary: El Conquistador is the world's most extreme survival and adventure reality show, set in the rugged Los Haitises National Park in the Dominican Republic. The new show follows 36 contestants divided into three teams, each led by a famous captain. The teams face extreme physical and mental challenges in each episode, contestants must overcome tough challenges and survive the wild nature, lack of food, and extreme weather conditions. The team that wins the immunity challenge receives the El Conquistador flag and enjoys time in the "Campamento Rico," (Wealthy Camp) filled with privileges such as food, fire, beds, and a private beach. The other two teams will be split between two camps known as "Pobre" and "Infernal," with one or more of their members facing an elimination challenge that could lead to their exit from the competition. The winner walks away the $200,000 prize and is crowned as El Conquistador.

name: La Mansión 24/7
summary: La Mansión is a new reality show that will allow audiences to have 24/7 access to the participants in their daily lives. In this reality show, the participants will face challenges that will test their resilience, inner strength, talent, and creativity. Only the best of them will win a cash prize and become the next face of the network.

name: Underdogs
summary: Hold on to your binoculars, folks, as Nat Geo gets up close and personal with the outcasts of the animal kingdom in Underdogs, narrated by Ryan Reynolds. From their hidden talents to their unconventional hygiene choices to their unsavory courtship rituals, Underdogs celebrates the unique behaviors of the animals who don't usually get to be the stars of the show.

name: Los Hilos del Pasado
summary: Carolina, a successful fashion designer, discovers that Cristina, the young model she's been mistreating, is her long-lost daughter, whom she was forced to abandon years ago.  As Carolina uncovers the truth, she will stop at nothing to mend their broken bond and unite the threads of fate and love.

name: Surviving the Amazon
summary:
Spanning nine South American countries, the Amazon is the largest rainforest on the planet. Home to over two and a half million species, each uniquely adapted to stay alive in a landscape of lush, tropical jungle.

Volatile weather, hungry predators and dangers lurking around every tree trunk, in Surviving the Amazon we explore just what it takes to grow-up, hunt, and find love when the odds are stacked against you.

name: The Black Dagger Brotherhood
summary: Based on the #1 NYT bestselling series by J.R. Ward, the league of vampire warriors known as the Black Dagger Brotherhood must fight against the Lessening Society to protect their race from extinction.

name: Nature's Fast Attacks
summary: Nature's Fast Attacks features heart-stopping footage from nature capturing the lightning-fast moves used to ambush prey and the equally rapid escape tactics used by some animals in the terrifying moments between life and death.

name: Bloomberg Brief
summary: Delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

name: Сказки живой природы
summary: A series of anti-stress films where the sights and sounds of nature are gracefully intertwined with words and intonations that will bring peace and balance to your soul.

name: Excused
summary: There is a litany of dating shows on TV so why not another one? This half-hour entry in the dating-show genre, hosted by comic Iliza Shlesinger (winner of "Last Comic Standing" season six), features a group of men vying for the affections of two women.

name: The Gift
summary: A mysterious gift brings misadventures when passed between friends. Henry and Ralf face hilarious predicaments, while Enzo and Leo must obey the holder's commands until the gift's power is revealed and transferred anew.

name: Hey Girl
summary: 'Hey Girl' is a half-hour comedy series focusing on the modern, web savvy young woman's reaction to dating, fashion, friendship, pop culture, body issues, embarrassing moments and much more. This series is comprised of an ensemble cast of popular comedians, bloggers and online personalities. Enhancing the talking head format are rotating man-on-the-street segments, sketches, musical parodies and animated pieces. Drawing from social platforms and web culture, nothing is off limits as each episode comments on the experience of a millennial girl in a comedic way.

previousepisode.name: Photoshopping, Nail Art and Crab Legs

name: Planet Shark
summary: For the first time, scientists are unlocking the secrets of sharks. Featuring newly discovered species, locations and behavior, The series combines stunning 4K archive footage with original content from the world's leading shark scientists to take a timely and in-depth look at the greatest predator on Earth.

name: An American Girl
summary: Experience the heartwarming journeys of your favorite American Girl characters from different historical periods.

previousepisode.name: Molly: An American Girl on the Home Front

name: Bloomberg Open Interest
summary: Delivers the market-moving news you need to know to get a jump start on the US trading day.

name: An American Girl
summary: Experience heartwarming tales of friendship, courage, and self-discovery with all new characters from American Girl.

name: Johnny Tsunami
summary: A young surfer from Hawaii navigates the challenges of friendship and family.

name: 90 Minutes
summary: When Las Navajas, a once-legendary amateur soccer team, is shaken by a scandalous brawl, their aging owner recruits washed-up local legend "Veneno" Montoya to coach the underdogs through a tournament filled with bitter rivalries, mafia threats, and impossible odds—igniting a wild journey to reclaim their honor and restore their neighborhood's pride.

previousepisode.name: Once a Navaja, Always a Navaja

name: Ce spun românii?
summary: Ce spun românii is the Romanian version of Family Feud, presented by Cabral Ibacka.

name: Sunt celebru, scoate-ma de aici!
summary: Romanian version of I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here!

name: Iubire și onoare
summary: Iubire și onoare is the story of a love affair between a Romanian woman and a sheikh from the Emirate of Beled el Nur, which presents as its main subject the crime of honor, still very common in some Arab states.

name: Dobre vedieť!
summary: A competitive, but mainly entertaining show, pitting the teams of Rob Jakab and Juraj Kemka against each other. Each of the captains, with the help of their guest, must find out the correct answers to unusual questions, often creating funny situations. Things get especially heated at the end of the show. The competing pairs have to answer a common question where they bet a sum of money that their opponents don't know the amount of. The winner is the team with the higher amount.

name: Marion Grasby's Flavours Of Heart & Home
Older Hotter Wiser
summary: A young woman is ready to take on Hollywood, but first, she must get there. When a logistical mishap forces her and her boyfriend onto a chaotic road trip to LA, what starts as a simple journey spirals into a wild ride filled with unexpected detours, mischief, and a reckoning with her past.

name: This Little Show of Mine
summary: Hayley Harris creates a one-woman stage show following the death of her mother in North Carolina.

name: Gettin' Cooked with Ricky
summary: Welcome to Ricky's new cooking show, where the best setting is BAKED! Get learnt as he and Randy compete to create the most delicious dishes, while high as fuck!

name: Flykten över kölen
summary:
Norwegian/ Swedish co production about refugees between Norway and Sweden during WW2 and the much debated and hated in Norway transition of german soldiers from Finland (eastern front) to Norway through Sweden 

production companies where NRK (1) and SVT Falun

Norway only had one channel in 1979-199x

name: Jack Hunter
summary: Exciting treasure hunt in beautiful and dangerous Syria, Turkey and Egypt.

previousepisode.name: Jack Hunter and the Star of Heaven

name: Kiseki Miracle Season
summary: Was it chance that we met? Or is it a miracle? Four times the charm, four kinds of handsome!

name: Family Recipe Showdown
summary: Going back to her Southern roots, Academy Award®-winning actress Octavia Spencer hosts a multi-generational home cooking competition that celebrates secret family recipes and traditions—where pride is on the line and the stakes are deeply personal as duos compete for a $10,000 prize. Set against the backdrop of New Orleans, Southern cooking royalty and expert judge Edgar "Dook" Chase is joined by guest judges and Octavia's celebrity friends, including Reese Witherspoon, Jessica Chastain, Danielle Brooks, Eric Stonestreet, Tina Knowles, Kandi Burrus, Tim Gunn, and Al Roker with his daughter Leila.

name: Guy's Flavortown Games
summary: Fresh off the season finale of Tournament of Champions, which delivered Food Network's highest-rated telecast in two years, Emmy® Award-winning host and restaurateur Guy Fieri brings his iconic Flavortown to life. In the new competition series Guy's Flavortown Games (wt), slated to premiere in early 2026 on Food Network and HBO Max®, two fearless chefs accept Guy's invitation to the epic restaurant row at the heart of Flavortown Square. Their goal: to prove they have the cooking cred to prepare a winning dish in any type of kitchen imaginable—from an awesome smashburger in the cramped food truck to a Michelin-worthy dinner in the state-of-the-art kitchen of a fine dining restaurant. The chef who makes the best dish in each round gets to choose their own culinary adventure by selecting the unique restaurant and cuisine they'll have to tackle next. In the town that Guy built, choosing the right restaurant can change your fortune.

name: Heart & Hustle: Houston
summary: Heart & Hustle: Houston (wt), produced by Jesse Collins Entertainment in their first-ever foray into the unscripted ensemble arena, follows a dynamic sisterhood of successful Black women in the vibrant heart of Houston. These women are redefining what it means to be a boss, a wife and a mother, while navigating a labyrinth of unique daily challenges. Despite appearing to ‘have it all,' they face insecurities and pressures to maintain a perfect image. Their unbreakable bond of friendship and support helps them rise above the chaos, reminding them it's okay to be ‘perfectly imperfect.'

name: They Know What They Did
summary: They Know What They Did explores a group of interconnected individuals haunted by a murder from their past. Blending a kaleidoscope of perspectives, each episode charts the journey to confront what really happened, revealing secrets and uncovering the truth. The stories unfold through first-person accounts of friends, family, locals, journalists and law enforcement.

name: Vanity Fair
summary: Vanity Fair, renowned for its in-depth investigative journalism and rich history of reporting on high-profile true crime cases, along with Dick Wolf, the mastermind behind iconic crime dramas, and his production company Wolf Entertainment are joining forces in an unprecedented collaboration to bring a compelling new series to Investigation Discovery, the leader in true crime programming. Together, they will present some of the most impactful stories with unparalleled access and exceptional reporting. This unique partnership will bring the incredible feature reporting of Vanity Fair to life in a new event anthology series helmed by best-in-class documentary filmmakers

name: Bachelor Mansion Takeover
summary: For more than 40 seasons, zealous fans have watched singletons find love within the iconic walls of the recurring Bachelor(ette) Mansion. Now, HGTV shines the light on this recognizable estate, giving the property the facelift it finally deserves. In the new competition twist from Warner Bros. Unscripted Television premiering in 2026 on HGTV and HBO Max®, former Bachelor and Bachelorette contestants who possess expert reno skills return to the house to duke it out in various design challenges with the hope of winning a cash prize.

name: The Dolls
summary: The Dolls, a reality TV dance series follows dance coach Dianna Williams and her Dancing Dolls, a group of talented young girls looking to better their futures at an HBCU and become professional dancers. A fresh DD4L elite team surfaces, as Dianna Williams looks to continue expanding her global brand, while balancing her life as a mother and wife.

name: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
summary:
Often referred to as the food capital of the world, France has long been synonymous with culinary excellence. In the tradition of her journeys in Searching for Mexico and Searching for Spain, Eva Longoria discovers the iconic origins of French cuisine, where the dining experience was first elevated to an art form. Throughout multiple regions, CNN Original Series Eva Longoria: Searching for France will be at the crossroads of centuries old gastronomic tradition and cutting-edge creativity in a country whose national identity is defined by its rich culinary history. 

A devoted Francophile whose career has taken her to France countless times, Longoria now goes deeper, savoring the traditions, innovations and regional flavors that have defined French cuisine for centuries. She spends real time with the chefs, artisans and families that both safeguard and evolve that extraordinary legacy. Along the way she uncovers the history that shaped it, from royal courts and monastic vineyards to the regional communities that turned local ingredients into enduring culinary traditions.

name: Tony Shalhoub Breaking Bread
summary:
Tony Shalhoub Breaking Bread introduces the authentic Tony behind the neurotic characters he plays – a passionate food-lover who comes from a large family of home cooks and is now deeply embedded in the New York restaurant world. In this delectable new docuseries, Shalhoub embarks on a mouthwatering, carb-filled journey around the world, with bread serving as the conduit into a variety of international cuisines and cultures. 

The ultimate comfort food, bread is the foundation for any shared meal, and Shalhoub will make and break bread with a cast of characters he picks up in every corner of the globe - local bakers, top chefs, home cooks, and everyone in between. From baguettes to buns, flatbreads to focaccias, and every grain in between, Shalhoub believes breaking bread has the power to bring people together. With each delicious bite, he takes viewers on a global adventure with communities united by this unassuming dinner table staple.

name: New Orleans
summary: New Orleans is a city unlike any other. Every day on its narrow and historic streets, it lives its culture out loud. From the sounds of live jazz, to the smell of warm beignets, to the ultimate party of all parties - Mardi Gras - the city communes with its history through music, food, sports and tradition. This four-part series tells its roaring story from its swampy founding to the present day. It uncovers the city through its trials and triumphs, and reveals how 20 years after Katrina, the city is louder and more resilient than ever. Voices include notable New Orleanians such as Emeril Lagasse, Wendell Pierce, Malcolm Jenkins, Trombone Shorty and James Carville.

name: Decades of Sports
summary: No single sport, season, game or player can adequately capture why athletic competition at the highest level is so wildly compelling. But taken as a whole, this six-part series will unravel the thrill of the victory and the agony of defeat across six decades of larger-than-life athletes, intense rivalries and stunning upsets that encapsulate the command sports have on our cultural attention.

name: This Land is Your Land
summary: Marking America's 250th birthday, This Land is Your Land tells the story of the dramatic transformation of six iconic locations throughout the nation's storied past, as titans of history clash to reshape the map and seize the future of the United States. As a young nation claims new territory and shapes its identity, this series illuminates how themes from America's past echo strongly in the present.

name: Доедешь – напиши
summary: The daily lives of people from different countries and unusual tourist routes. A vibrant reality show featuring Russian celebrities.

name: Monteverde
summary: Fleeing from a crime she didn't commit, a woman with a strong and charismatic personality will have to replace her nun sister and hide in a town, Monteverde, where threats of love, the misfortunes of the people, and, worst of all, the danger of being discovered.

name: Papás por Siempre
summary: Papás por Siempre is a touching and multifaceted story, focused on positive messages and celebrate second chances and the power of love. It sensitively and realistically portrays blended families navigating the emotional journey of merging different worlds under one roof. At the Guevara-Mosqueda household, time has passed: new lives are born, old wounds resurface, and buried secrets threaten to disrupt the fragile family harmony. When the past comes knocking—through absent parents, unexpected children, and long-hidden truths—Tino and Aidé must fight to keep their family together or risk losing everything. With touches of nostalgia, heartfelt musical moments, and surprising twists, the story offers a fresh take on love, fatherhood, and emotional healing.

name: Regalo de Amor
summary: After losing all hope of becoming a mother, a young woman is widowed due to a sudden accident in which her husband dies. This leads her to discover a whole parallel life and a past full of secrets, in addition to having to take care of a little girl, who mysteriously appears registered as her daughter.
